decision: Sam's explicit decision of 2026-11-04 in Claude Code session f804490c: "全部批准，我作為project owner 批準你幫我發digest", answering the consolidated proposals for the HD-019 Purchasing lookups (6 new functional integration cases), and a one-time project-owner authorization for the agent to publish this receipt's digest
purpose: The seven purchasing-lookups routes work with purchasing.mgmt alone, refuse purchasing.view, no token and stale permissions; Suppliers, SKUs, Currencies, Payment Terms, warehouses and Buyers return only what a new PO accepts; Supplier defaults carry no internal fields; failures map to the documented codes
data: Each case commits 4 users and roles, 2 Payment Terms, 5 Suppliers, 1 address, 1 Item, 3 UOMs, 4 SKUs with their mappings, 3 barcodes and 2 warehouses over real HTTP and MySQL, and deletes them afterwards. No fixture files
thresholds: All cases pass; coverage floors unchanged
trigger: Routine correctness regression on every PR and push to main, in the existing server coverage shards
cost: Measured locally with coverage: about 5 s for the file, including 6 application starts. CI not measured, estimated about 5 s on one shard. No new job and no capacity
